text:
Grace: Heads up for EOM  Orion Labs invoice INV-2026-7710 shows duplicate spot credits applied then reversed by a backfill, leaving AR mismatches. Need guidance for revrec impact.
Owen: Can you paste the lines and what backfill did?
Grace: Snippet from invoice and post-backfill adjustment below:
```
2026-03-08 hosted-inference orion@orionlabs.com 10,000 tokens  list_charge=10000.00  spot_credit_applied=true  net_charge=6000.00
2026-03-09 hosted-inference orion@orionlabs.com 5,500 tokens  list_charge=5500.00  spot_credit_applied=true  net_charge=3300.00
---
Backfill executed 2026-03-20: refunded spot credits then reapplied them leading to two credit memos created then cancelled. AR shows temp credit CM-2026-1101 then CM-2026-1101-rev.
```
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-7710 posted 2026-03-15. Tags: orion, spot-experiment.
Clara: From accounting  if credits posted then reversed, revenue and AR could be oscillating. For month close we should capture net economic effect. What's the net overstated / understated amount?
Marcus: I ran a quick recon sheet: net impact at period end is 0 at the AR level, but revenue was recognized incorrectly when the initial credit applied. Net recognized revenue is overstated by 9,200.00 USD because the reversal didn't adjust the revenue schedule.
Owen: That makes sense. Experiment PX-03-ORION had a race condition in backfill job BF-773 which created duplicate credit flow. Ops ticket OP-5567 open.
Grace: Options from billing side: 1) post correcting credit memos now (CM-2026-1110) which will alter AR before close; 2) book an accrual/reversal in revenue accounts to reflect economic impact and reverse when final memos settle.
Clara: Accounting prefers an adjusting JE to keep AR motion minimal at close and not touch cash. Proposed JE: debit 4005 (Revenue) 9,200.00; credit 2108 (Accrued Credits) 9,200.00. Memo: "Orion Labs spot backfill race condition  EOM adjusting accrual". Reversal in April after billing finalizes.
Marcus: Finance concurs, but we need CFO sign-off for anything > $5k that affects revenue accounts. Marcus: tagging @close-bot for approval workflow.
close-bot: Routing approval request to CFO. Amount: 9200.00 USD. Approvers required: CFO, Controller. Deadline: 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC.
Owen: I'll attach the experiment logs and BF-773 run id to the JE. Also will coordinate with billing to avoid double memos.
Grace: I'll hold off on creating CM-1110 until JE posted. Will update AR if billing finalizes before reversal date.
Clara: JE prepared: JE-2026-03-ORI-04 amount=9200.00 USD. Attachments: recon workbook https://internal.redwood/finance/recon/orion-bf773-2026-03.xlsx (sheet: net-impact), OP-5567, BF-773 logs. Reversal scheduled 2026-04-06.
close-bot: Approval received from Controller (Marta). CFO approval pending.
Marcus: Once CFO approves, please post JE and include it in the close pack. Also add a short risk note to month-end pack re: experiment/backfill controls.
Grace: Will update thread with CM ids or reversal posting. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
